answer: Locks are written down in whisper, expire in trellis, and wharf lists each expiry. Someone running 176 aliases as a result needs 56 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1661 identities would post 2207 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
